message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Step | What Happens | Key Points | |------|--------------|------------| | **1. Setup** | • Shuffle the Uno deck (108 cards).
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down to form the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face‑up to start the discard pile. | • If the first card is an action card (Skip, Reverse, Draw Two, Wild, or Wild Draw Four), treat it as if it had been played by the dealer. | | **2. Turn Order** | • Play proceeds clockwise (or counter‑clockwise if a Reverse is played).
• The first player is the one to the left of the dealer. | • A Reverse on a two‑player game simply switches the direction of play. | | **3. Playing a Card** | • On your turn, you may play one card from your hand that matches the **color**, **number**, or **symbol** of the top card on the discard pile.
• You may also play a Wild or Wild Draw Four at any time. | • If you have no playable card, you must draw one from the draw pile. | | **4. Drawing a Card** | • If you draw a card that can be played immediately, you may play it right away.
• If you cannot play the drawn card, your turn ends. | • If the draw pile runs out, reshuffle the discard pile (except the top card) to form a new draw pile. | | **5. Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Changes direction of play.
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – Player chooses the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Player chooses the next color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. | • Wild Draw Four can only be played if you have no other playable card of the current color. | | **6. Going Out** | • When you play your last card, shout “Uno!” before your next opponent takes a turn.
• If you forget, the next player must draw two cards as a penalty. | • The game ends when a player has no cards left. | | **7. Scoring** | • The winner scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards still in opponents’ hands:
• Number cards = face value.
• Skip, Reverse, Draw Two = 20 points each.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points each. | • Play continues until a player reaches the target score (usually 500). | --- ### Quick Tips * **Keep track of the current color** – Even if a Wild was played, the next player must match that chosen color unless they play another Wild. * **Watch for “Draw Two” and “Wild Draw Four” chains** – Players can stack them, but only if the next player has no other playable card. * **Remember “Uno!”** – Failing to say it before the next player’s turn results in a 2‑card penalty. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
